title: Detailed helicopter
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox='0 0 100 100'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7ec8ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2b8ad6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='body2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4fa8e8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1c6aa8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- main rotor blades -->
  <rect x='14' y='18' width='72' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#c9d8e4'/>
  <rect x='14' y='18' width='72' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#eef6ff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='11' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#8fa6b8'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='18' r='3.2' fill='#dce8f2'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='18' r='1.4' fill='#9fb4c6'/>

  <!-- tail boom -->
  <path d='M62 55 L92 50 L92 56 L62 62 Z' fill='#3e93c9'/>
  <path d='M62 55 L92 50 L92 52 L62 58 Z' fill='#66b4e0'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M88 50 L98 42 L100 52 L92 56 Z' fill='#2b7db3'/>
  <!-- tail rotor -->
  <rect x='92' y='40' width='2.5' height='20' rx='1.2' fill='#dfeaf3'/>
  <circle cx='93.2' cy='51' r='2.4' fill='#a8bccb'/>

  <!-- skids -->
  <rect x='24' y='80' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8fa2b2'/>
  <rect x='24' y='80' width='40' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c7d6e2'/>
  <rect x='30' y='68' width='4' height='13' rx='1.5' fill='#7d90a0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='68' width='4' height='13' rx='1.5' fill='#7d90a0'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='54' rx='28' ry='15' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='50' rx='24' ry='9' fill='#a5dbff' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <path d='M66 46 Q76 48 74 56 Q72 62 64 61 Q60 54 66 46 Z' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <path d='M68 49 Q73 51 71 57 Q68 58 66 54 Q66 50 68 49 Z' fill='#eafcff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- engine housing -->
  <rect x='38' y='36' width='20' height='8' rx='3' fill='#255f8a'/>
  <rect x='40' y='37.5' width='16' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#5c9cc9'/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <rect x='56' y='40' width='6' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#3a4756'/>

  <!-- stripe detail -->
  <path d='M26 58 Q46 64 66 58' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M28 62 Q46 67 64 62' stroke='#ff7b54' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none'/>

  <!-- rotor mast -->
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='9' height='9' rx='2' fill='#7d90a0'/>
  <rect x='45.5' y='30' width='3' height='9' fill='#b3c3d1'/>
</svg>
